findings.evidence: campaign_cases.py line 238-240 (boots case offhand=False); rows campaign31 offhand equip_*/r6 route: right-click equip into the feet slot (14 NA_OFFHAND_NOT_APPLICABLE)
findings.description: Right-click equipping boots does have an off-hand variant in vanilla (Equippable swap works from either hand), so NA_OFFHAND_NOT_APPLICABLE is not strictly 'a route with no off-hand variant'. The off-hand right-click equip path is covered by the 9 helmet/elytra offhand PASS rows and the guard is item-identity based, so the risk is low; label it as covered elsewhere instead.

No case puts chestplates or leggings into the chest/legs slots (slot 7, chest only via elytra); the head, feet and chest(elytra) slots are tested. The guard keys on exact item identity (NativeEquipmentAbilities.java:12-14 lists CHESTPLATE and LEGGINGS), so this is a coverage note, not a defect.
The state probe reports the tested equip ability as null; lock state is inferred from count < threshold, overlay and the server armor probe.
